auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to plan your next walk.
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.useMagicLink: Email me a sign-in link instead
auth.magicLinkSubtitle: We'll email you a link and a 6-digit code. No password needed.
auth.magicLinkSent: We sent a link and a code to {{email}}. Open the link on this device, or enter the code below.
auth.confirmEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.

explore.title: Where to next?
explore.subtitle: Pick a destination to see what to know before you go, explore attractions and plan a walking route.
explore.mapLabel: Map of attractions. Use the list view for an accessible list.
explore.noCitiesBody: Reference data has not been loaded. Run the data pipeline seeds and try again.

home.cityNotFoundBody: This destination isn't available. Pick one of the cities we cover.

attraction.dataCredit: Data from Wikidata (CC0) and © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Opening hours may be out of date.

checklist.title: Before you go
checklist.intro: Personalised to your passports and travel dates.
checklist.datesHint: Use YYYY-MM-DD; departure must be after arrival.
checklist.error: We couldn't load the checklist. Check your connection and try again.
checklist.needNationality: Add your nationality to see a personalised checklist.
checklist.disclaimer: Entry rules change. Always confirm with the official embassy or government website before travelling.

visa.title: Visa
visa.citizen: You're a citizen: no visa needed
visa.disclaimer: Based on the open passport-index dataset.

advice.citizen: Enter with your national passport or ID card.
advice.freedom_of_movement: Free movement applies: bring a valid passport or national ID card.
advice.visa_free: No visa needed for short tourist stays.
advice.visa_on_arrival: You can get a visa on arrival. Bring cash and check fees in advance.
advice.eta: You need an electronic travel authorisation before you travel.
advice.e_visa: Apply online for an e-visa before you travel.
advice.visa_required: You need a visa from the embassy or consulate before you travel.
advice.no_admission: Entry is currently not allowed with this passport.

rule.free_movement: Your passport or ID card must be valid for the whole stay.
rule.schengen_3m_after_departure: Schengen rule: valid for at least 3 months after you leave, and issued in the last 10 years.
rule.whole_stay: Must be valid for the whole of your stay.
rule.tr_150d_after_arrival: Must be valid for at least 150 days from the day you arrive.
rule.generic_6m_after_arrival: Many countries and airlines require 6 months of validity from arrival.

validity.warning: Your passport meets the rule with little margin. Consider renewing.
validity.problem: Your passport does not meet this rule. Renew it before travelling.
validity.unknown: Add your passport expiry date in your profile to check this.

power.title: Power and plugs
power.noAdapter: Your plugs fit: no adapter needed.
power.voltageWarning: The voltage is different from home. Check your devices support it (most chargers do) or bring a converter.

weather.title: Weather
weather.climate: Typical {{month}} weather (average of the last {{years}} years)

safety.title: Safety

level.1: Exercise a high degree of caution.

safety.regional: Some regions have specific advisories: read the full advice.

route.title: Walking route
route.stopsHint: Pick between {{min}} and {{max}} places in any order. The first one is your starting point; the rest are ordered for the shortest walk.
route.startedNewCity: Started a new route in this city.
route.optimizeError: We couldn't optimise the route. Try again.
route.fallbackNotice: Estimated from straight-line distances: the walking directions service was unavailable.
route.emptyBody: Open a place on the map and tap “Add to route”.
route.openGoogleMaps: Open the whole walk in Google Maps
route.googleLimit: Google Maps shows up to 9 intermediate stops; use the per-leg links for the rest.
route.legByLeg: Or navigate one leg at a time:
route.autoOrderHint: Ordered for the shortest walk from your first stop.
route.manualOrderHint: You changed the order by hand. New places are slotted in where they add the least walking.
route.splitBody: Too much for one walk? Split the stops into balanced routes — each about the same time (visits + walking) with the shortest walks — for one day or part of the trip each. Every route is optimised on its own.
route.saveSplitHint: Each route is saved as its own trip.

trips.title: My Trips
trips.empty: You haven't saved any trips yet. Build a walking route from the map and save it here.
trips.deleteConfirm: Delete this trip? This can't be undone.
trips.subtitle: Your saved walking routes, ready for the day.

profile.title: Profile
profile.nationalitiesHint: Add every passport you hold: we'll pick the best entry option.
profile.homeCountryHint: Used for plugs, voltage and currency comparisons.
profile.passportExpiryHint: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to skip.
profile.privacyNote: We never store passport numbers or scans, only the optional expiry date.
profile.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, profile and saved trips.

about.title: About
about.body: Wayfarer helps you prepare for a trip and explore a city on foot.
